notes.title: Gal*Gun Returns Update
notes.content:
Hey Gal*Gunners!

We hope you are enjoying Gal*Gun Returns! Thank you for your feedback so far. Today we have made some updates to improve your gameplay experience:

[b]Adjustments[/b]
　・[Edit] The flickering cycle of the shell that appears around the Japanese text that appears when a girl shouts things at you has been adjusted to reduce photosensitivity issues.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
　・Fixed an issue that was causing the game to crash during the Good Ending segment of Akira's route.
　・Fixed an issue that was causing the speed of the aiming sight to not calculate correctly.
　・Fixed a number of minor display issues found in 60FPS mode.

notes.title: Gal*Gun Demo Update
notes.content:
Hey Gal*Gunners!

Thank you for reporting your issues for the Steam Festival Demo build. Today we have released a new update: 

[b]Additions:[/b]

・1440p and 2160p screen size options have been added to the options menu

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

・An issue that caused the game not to go into a proper full-screen mode on certain monitor resolutions has been fixed.
・Further fixes have been made to address the issue of the game not being able to save data properly.


Thank you for checking out Gal*Gun Returns! The Steam Festival demo ends on Tuesday, February 9th, 2021 @ 10AM PST, so there’s still a little more time to play before the launch on 12th February.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1425730/GalGun_Returns/
